title: Free cluster and molecule geometry optimization
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization for the isolated Si5 (trigonal bipyramid), Si6 (tetragonal bipyramid), Si7 (pentagonal bipyramid) clusters, and the isolated C2H4 molecule. The optimized atomic coordinates serve as reference structures for subsequent adsorption energy calculations.
description: Optimize reference structures for free silicon clusters and ethylene. Evidence includes XYZ files with final coordinates.

title: Adsorption complex relaxations
action: For each cluster, build initial adsorption geometries at the required sites: Si5: atop_capped, atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge; Si6: atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge; Si7: short_bridge. Relax these complexes using DFT. Record total energies and final coordinates for each site.
evidence: adsorption_results/ (directory with relaxation logs and coordinates)
description: Run all DFT relaxations needed to obtain adsorption energies and geometries. Evidence can be a directory with energy and coordinate files.

title: Si5 adsorption energies
action: From the relaxed complexes, compute adsorption energies E_ads = E_complex - E_si5 - E_c2h4 for each of the four Si5 adsorption sites. Write a CSV with columns site and energy_eV.
description: Scored artifact containing adsorption energies for all four Si5 sites. The checker compares values to reference and verifies that the short_bridge energy is the highest.
output_schema: columns: site (string), energy_eV (float). Sites: atop_capped, atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge.

title: Si5 short bridge structure parameters
action: From the relaxed short_bridge complex of Si5, extract the C-C bond length (Å), Si1-C bond length (Å), Si4-C bond length (Å), CH2 scissor plane bend angle (degrees), and the cluster distances d1-2 (Å), d1-4 (Å), d4-5 (Å). Write a CSV with columns parameter and value.
description: Scored artifact containing key structural parameters of the most favored Si5 adsorption site. Checker compares each value to reference within tolerance.
output_schema: columns: parameter (string), value (float). Required parameters: C-C_bond_length, Si1-C_bond_length, Si4-C_bond_length, CH2_bend_angle, d1-2, d1-4, d4-5.

title: Si6 adsorption energies
action: Compute adsorption energies for the three Si6 sites (atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge) as E_ads = E_complex - E_si6 - E_c2h4. Write a CSV with columns site and energy_eV.
description: Scored artifact containing adsorption energies for Si6 sites. Checker verifies values and that atop_side energy is the highest.
output_schema: columns: site (string), energy_eV (float). Sites: atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge.

title: Si7 adsorption energy
action: Compute adsorption energy for the Si7 short_bridge site. Write a CSV with columns site and energy_eV.
description: Scored artifact containing the short_bridge adsorption energy for Si7.
